Itineraries

Curated Berlin plans, ready to follow

Time slots, concrete sights, transit and restaurant tips - and at the end of every plan a hotel suggestion that fits the neighborhood.

Berlin is large, and the most common mistake on a short trip is not which sights you pick but the order you pick them in: combine Museum Island, the East Side Gallery and Charlottenburg in one day and you will spend a good two hours on the U-Bahn. Our plans are therefore sorted by route, not by ranking.

Each plan groups places reachable on foot or on a single line, gives a realistic time span per stop, and ends with a district where staying overnight fits the programme. The plans combine: the three-day classic covers the landmarks, while the family day and the rainy-day plan are designed to replace a single day when the weather or your company changes the plan.

3 Days · First-time visitors

3 days in Berlin

The classic first-timer itinerary: landmarks in Mitte, Wall history in Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg, Charlottenburg and Tiergarten on day three.

Coooohen · CC BY-SA 4.0
2 Days · Families with kids (ages 4-12)

Berlin with kids

Family weekend in Berlin: Zoo, Tempelhof Field, Mauerpark flea market and the Natural History Museum - kid-friendly, with breaks.

1 Day · Anyone caught in the rain

Berlin when it rains

A rainy day in Berlin: three museums on Museum Island, lunch in the market hall, evening at KaDeWe or Sony Center.
